reference: RawAsset Sprite/0132 (Ditto), body-only timing/closure/rotation conventions, not anatomy transfer

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Side audition confirms two squash/bounce cycles. Fixed contact preserves actual root lift; cyclic sampling omits duplicated endpoint.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Reviewed native side roll: compressed anticipation, rolling body impact near 1.1s, upright recovery. No hand strike.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native smaller forward lunge supplies a restrained body-pulse release gesture. NOT evidence of a source projectile or mouth mechanism. Procedural adaptation is retiming/contact stabilization; pinned Ditto Shoot delegates to body Charge. No projectile painted.
actions.root_motion_policy: J_root local X/Z fixed at native clip t=0; native Y, rotation, scale and all child deformation retained. Engine logical travel is not baked into this sprite gesture.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native low resting posture, source eyes stay open. Explicit source-eye mask closes the white eye to a dark lid; slow two-pose breathing adapted from pinned Ditto timing.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Side audition shows whole-body recoil/tip then return. No invented limb response.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Same evidenced native roll, explicitly adapted to a whole-body lateral sweep using restrained yaw (-30 to +45 degrees); limb-free procedural interpretation, not a claimed native named Swing.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two retimed native short body lunges, visible contacts at frames 3 and 9. Engine exposes one HitFrame (first contact); second contact recorded here, not fabricated gameplay damage.
actions.root_motion_policy: J_root local X/Z fixed at native clip t=0; native Y, rotation, scale and all child deformation retained. Engine logical travel is not baked into this sprite gesture.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: One observed half-cycle bounce, unlike two-cycle Walk. Fixed baseline contact retains source airborne arc with extended apex timing.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Audition shows native body/head gather and ear tilt; retimed as restrained charge-up, no invented energy effect. Interpretation uncertain until visual review; not semantic inference from clip suffix.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Explicit procedural full-body yaw over native neutral breathing; pinned Ditto rotation convention. Not a native rotation clip, and not an Idle copy.
